title: Emerging network pattern review
scope: Detect unexplained network patterns with explainable evidence and analyst review queue

acceptance.text: Detect unexplained network patterns with explainable evidence and analyst review queue
Novelty alone cannot trigger enforcement; evaluate false positives and source gaps
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Novelty alone cannot trigger enforcement; evaluate false positives and source gaps

evidence.text: ai/workflows/network_patterns.py detect_patterns (TAX-053 read-access check first) reads one tenant's TAX-074 case graphs and finds recurring structures - shared intermediary/adviser (>=3 cases), common beneficial owner (>=2), scheme linked to >=3 cases, circular ownership within a case - each explained by its supporting edges with provenance, source record and evidence citations. Patterns fully cited in every supporting case are queued for analyst review (route analyst_review, decided_by analyst, outcome null), ordered by evidence completeness, never by risk.

tests/ai/test_network_patterns.py (8 tests on real sg.build_case_graph output): queued patterns cite evidence on every edge; novelty is reported (baseline comparison) but novelty_alone_sufficient false, enforcement_action null and novelty changes no status; one case with uncited adviser edges turns shared_intermediary into insufficient_evidence with edge_without_cited_evidence source gaps; circular ownership detected; TAX-074 labelling_terms finds no labelling words in output and no score/risk fields; evaluate_reviews reports false_positive_share and source_gap_share per pattern type and refuses unknown outcomes; taxpayer caller and cross-tenant graphs refused; deterministic under reorder/duplicates. .venv-ai pytest tests/ai: 295 passed; ruff/mypy (206 files) pass; TAX-056 gate PASS.

Tests and evidence recorded on task/TAX-075 (criteria 1-2). Branch refreshed from main (clean merge, tests rerun), pushed explicitly; human-review PR https://github.com/Vati-AI/rsl-taxathon/pull/208 opened with the CI billing block documented. Agent will not merge.

notes.text: Agent finished implementation and opened human review. task.py finish steps run individually: its dev.py check/quality.py gate fails on this Windows checkout only (POSIX file-mode tooling tests; CRLF vs Prettier), documented in the PR.
